label: Sanders, Randy

label: Goff, Philip

notes: The birth mismatch reflects two namesakes and a conflated Wikidata item, rather than a correction to the LC scholar's birth year. The supported year above is for the LC person. LC's linked Q112457426 currently redirects to the disputed item, so it is not a usable separate replacement; no distinct current QID was verified.

label: Aguilar, George

label: Graham, P. J. (Philip Jeremy)
lc_person: Philip Jeremy Graham, born 1932; child psychiatrist at the Hospital for Sick Children and emeritus professor of child psychiatry at the Institute of Child Health, London.
item_person: Philip Graham, born 1951; novelist, short-story writer and editor associated with the University of Illinois; the item also contains identifiers belonging to the child psychiatrist.
notes: The supported birth year is for the LC psychiatrist. This is a conflated Wikidata item, rather than a simple birth-year typo: its description, birth statement and Wikipedia sitelink identify the writer, while its authority identifiers identify the psychiatrist. The graph's LC assignment fits its name and matching Open Library works. No separate QID for the psychiatrist was confidently identified.

label: Ford, Alan

LC itself links to Q4706635, but its work and affiliation notes identify the historian. No separate Wikidata item for the LC person was verified.

label: Andrew Schumann

Birth year left unresolved for the LC scholar: 1983 is an LC ECIP statement, not independently verified here. No separate QID for the scholar was verified. LC and Wikidata were inspected through their structured exports after ordinary page access failed.

label: Pritchard, James

label: De La Cova, Antonio

label: Homan, Michael
